title: Summer compost pickup, said twice
transcript:
Nina Patel (owner): Green Bin can keep the alley clear through August.
Nina Patel (owner): I'll pay Green Bin Compost $315 for the summer pickup.
Nina Patel (owner): So, to recap, I'll pay Green Bin Compost $315 for the summer pickup.

traps.description: Nina says the same $315 twice, and a second draft would pay it twice.
